decisions.reason: As a niche coffee-based men's care line, it is less clearly anchored in the firm's likely core cosmetic-chemical knowledge base and with only launch-year evidence visible, management would be relatively likely to redeploy resources to better-supported lines or development projects.

The facial cleansing foam is an incremental extension of the existing Sandorini series, so it fits the firm's prior formulation and branding knowledge well and is therefore more likely to be retained and improved than withdrawn.
